entries.title: Chants of Sennaar
entries.definitive_edition: Chants of Sennaar on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.why: The Windows PC version is the best archive route because it has the complete language-decoding adventure in a native release with PC capture/settings flexibility. Console and mobile versions are documented access routes, but no sourced platform-exclusive gameplay content over PC is documented.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Chants of Sennaar on Steam, Epic Games Store, or the Focus store for Windows PC and play the current native PC build.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or content-expanded edition is documented; the mobile release is a later access route.
